facts.activity_file: working live under a documented justification

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: audit finding - spot check of key safeguard at SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on SG-9000 and TX-9001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on SG-9000 and TX-9001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 3 December 2008 a planned spot check of SG-9000 and TX-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop found the earth leakage and protection setting integrity not effective.
